the use of the reversible medium voltage AC drive allows us to increase the power factor from 0.7 to 0.9, and reduce the reactive power from 0.5 to 0.1 MVAR, which is a significant energy-efficiency improvement in the industrial grid.

the use of the reversible 18-pulse main electric drive with 3L-NCP AFE rectifiers and PWM SHE control allows us to reduce the THD in the industrial grid to the permissible level, to correct the power factor in the grid, and to increase the energy efficiency of the industrial grid.
